title: PAM: code for cryptic binding site prediction with tabular in-context learning
description: Source code for PAM, which predicts cryptic binding site residues from apo protein structures with TabICLv2 over 53 structural features and 64 principal components of a cross-fitted fine-tuned ESM-2 3B embedding. Includes feature construction, fold-model fine-tuning, evaluation on CryptoBench, and the scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the accompanying manuscript, Tabular In-Context Learning for Cryptic Site Prediction (submitted to Bioinformatics).
